section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants in a single study (Study X) consisting of 247 Black female adolescents recruited from colleges in the southeastern United States. The sample included students from a predominantly White institution (PWI; n=38) and two Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs; n=209), with a mean age of 17.8 years and mean BMI of 25.4 kg/m². The BMI distribution showed 51% normal weight, 20% overweight, and 22.4% obese participants.
